ISO_11469_Plastic_Recycling.title: Plastic-recyc-13.svg
ISO_11469_Plastic_Recycling.description: Plastic recycle logo ASA. The outdated ASTM standard only includes the codes 1 to 7 for plastics, whereby ASA and many other polymers are all summarised under "7" for "Other". A Chinese standard breaks down this collective group much more comprehensively, with the plastic ASA, which is widely used in the automotive sector in particular, but also in 3D printing due to its UV resistance, being assigned the code "13". The adoption of these codes for international use is currently under discussion.

The outdated ASTM standard only includes the codes 1 to 7 for plastics, whereby ASA and many other polymers are all summarised under "7" for "Other". A Chinese standard breaks down this collective group much more comprehensively, with the plastic ASA, which is widely used in the automotive sector in particular, but also in 3D printing due to its UV resistance, being assigned the code "13". The adoption of these codes for international use is currently under discussion.
